notes.title: What Are We Working on for Version 1.0?
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, Demon Hunters![/h3]

It’s been a while since I’ve shared updates about the game’s development. I usually post more on Discord about what we’re working on, but for those who aren’t in the server: the game is still in development—and it’s getting better and better!

We’re preparing a MASSIVE update for next year. Bigger than anything we’ve ever done before. It will feature[b] more enemies, elite enemies, boss fights, new environments, NPCs, a new damage system with elemental synergies, a revamped upgrade system, a skill tree, passive abilities for characters[/b], and much more.

Here’s a sneak peek at what we’re working on:

[h1]New Enemies[/h1]
There will be new enemies with unique behaviors. We're also reworking the enemies already in the game.

notes.title: Biggest Update to date! V 0.9 is here
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes - Version Beta 0.9[/h1]

[h1]New Feature:[/h1]
[h2]You can now revive using your Demon Horns.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982720/46fcdcbb8fdecf2a6966d04ac88dbd91bd81286b.png[/img]


[h2]Reworks & Improvements:[/h2]

[h3]Physics Improvements:[/h3]

Fireball enemy bodies are now pushed with the force of the last shot.
Large larva bodies now have physics.
Improved physics for enemy body impacts: they no longer bounce like footballs.
Improved explosion physics: damage increases the closer the target is to the epicenter, and pushes enemies based on their distance from the epicenter. The player needs to be very close to the explosion to take damage.

[h3]Cemetery Gates Rework:[/h3]

Removed one of the purposeless gates.
Better weapons distributed in the initial area.

[h3]Weapon Improvements:[/h3]

Buffed grenade launcher: more bullets and larger explosion radius.
Improvements to all explosive weapons.
Upgrades to most weapons.
Buff to Azau's dash.
Buff to Azau's knife.
Buff to Big Iron: more damage, faster bullets, greater knockback.
Buff to various other weapons.
Reworked bullet physics on enemies: bullets now push enemies according to shot speed.
Bullets push enemies farther.
Applied bullet physics to flying enemies: flyers now recoil from shots.

[h3]General Improvements:[/h3]

Striker can now be upgraded at Caishen.
Damage numbers now appear with explosions.
Prices of doors and weapons shown in green when affordable. In red only when not.
Animation when earning more points.
Pop-up animation for hit indicators on enemies.
Floating text indicating the amount of points earned.
New players start the game with 10 Demon Horns.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

Fixed the bug causing OctoHead projectiles to move strangely when hit and when dying.
Fixed the bug with controller input when selecting the language on the first game launch.
More than 3 runes in the inventory no longer get cut off.

[h3]Gameplay Adjustments:[/h3]

Easy mode temporarily removed.
Faster pacing: new hordes start more quickly.
Different types of enemies now spawn at the beginning of the game.
More points awarded per kill.
Rain effect during multiple waves of 5. OctoHead now spawns in waves 5, 10, and 15.
Renamed Extra Ammo Rune to Extended Mag for better clarity.

notes.title: Beta - Version 0.8 is now live!
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
Sound bugs have been addressed and fixed, ensuring a more immersive and glitch-free gaming experience.

[h3]Quality of Life Improvements:[/h3]
Shortcuts are now more affordable, making navigation through the game world smoother and more accessible for players.

[h3]Level Design Enhancements:[/h3]
The map has been expanded, featuring areas with fewer obstacles to reduce the chances of players being easily cornered by enemies.

[h3]Spawn Point Variation:[/h3]
Players now spawn at random positions, introducing greater variability to each playthrough and adding an element of unpredictability to the game.

[h3]Boss Encounter Changes:[/h3]
Alkarion, the boss, now spawns at a random position on the map, adding an extra layer of challenge and excitement to the encounter.

[h3]Temporary Map Disablement:[/h3]
The map has been temporarily disabled for adjustments and improvements. Stay tuned for its reintegration in future updates!

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope these changes enhance your gaming experience in Version 0.8.

notes.title: "Raining Blood: Hellfire" Early Access Version Now Available!
notes.notes:
"Raining Blood: Hellfire" is a dungeon shooter game inspired by COD's zombie mode, Enter the Gungeon, and vampire survivor games. The early access version is now available on Steam, starting at 4 dollars with a 10% discount for the first week.

In this top-notch dungeon shooting game, you will play as a fearless demon hunter, fighting your way through hell! The game offers unlimited skill upgrades and a wide variety of carefully designed guns. In each battle wave, strive to beat your own shortest time, collect resources, and challenge speed runs!

Join Discord community 

Discord: https://discord.gg/Ds96P6Mezf
